image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a tiger beetle being held between a human thumb and index finger. The beetle displays metallic bronze and green coloration with distinct pale markings on its elytra. Its large compound eyes, long mandibles, and slender legs are clearly visible against the skin texture of the fingers.
